name: Explicit Tone Mapping
definition: A module converting HDR image Ih to LDR image Il using a function T parameterized by radiometric parameters θ, consisting of white balance w and camera response function (CRF) g.
summary: Explicit Tone Mapping is a global function that converts HDR to LDR images by simulating camera response with exposure scaling, white balance, and a parameterized CRF, applying a uniform transformation across the entire image.
